findings.section: Proposed fix (first principles) — Notes / what could go wrong
findings.problem: The report claims the regex /^~[^/]*(?:\/|$)/ deliberately keeps '~$report.docx' and '~notes.md' as legitimate relative names. That is false: '[^/]*' consumes the whole first segment and '$' then always matches, so the regex is equivalent to /^~/ and rejects every path starting with '~'.
findings.evidence: node /tmp/bb-reports/issues/1182/verify/regex.js prints true for '~notes.md', '~$report.docx', '~notes.md:3', '~foo/bar.md' as well as '~', '~/x', '~user/x.md'.
findings.fix: Either state honestly that the fix rejects any href beginning with '~' (probably acceptable) or change the regex to something like /^~[A-Za-z0-9._-]*(?:\/|$)/ combined with an explicit list, and add '~notes.md' as a positive (still-linkified) test case so the claim is actually verified.

findings.problem: Ports (25374/33374), host id (host_7jfebaa4wr) and project/thread ids are the author's instance values but are given as literal commands; and the scratch-repo line ends with 'cd /tmp/bb-1182-scratch', so the next line 'pnpm bb:dev machine list' fails with ERR_PNPM_NO_IMPORTER_MANIFEST_FOUND when followed literally.
findings.evidence: Running the block verbatim from a fresh shell: pnpm bb:dev machine list -> 'No package.json ... was found in /tmp/bb-1182-verify-scratch'. My instance printed App :14920 / Server :22920 / host_ai8j9cyts3.
findings.fix: Use eval "$(scripts/bb-dev-app env)" (or say 'substitute the ports/host id printed for your instance'), run the scratch git init in a subshell, and note that the CLI must be run from the repo root.
